newsitems.title: Technical Playtest is now fully open with no NDA
newsitems.author: Seraxia
newsitems.contents: It’s been fantastic to see all the feedback and comments coming into Discord as people have been playing the Playtest, and it's been so positive that we've decided to let everyone participate if they want to! As such, we’re opening up the playtest with no NDA, however, the playtest will close next week, so jump in while you can!What to expect:This is a technical playtest, which means that some features that will be in the early access release are removed or turned off. This build is also a work in progress, so you will likely run into balance issues, bugs, crashes, and content that doesn't work as intended at this stage. What is in the playtest?Progression is limited and ends before Birch Trees.Regarding Väsen in the playtest: For the purposes of this tech test, we have currently removed the feature that includes befriending Väsen. For that, you will have to wait for Early AccessAs such, you will likely find them interacting in unintended ways (fighting a bit more In the future, just as in the Dark Forest itself, you should be able to get to know the Väsen and play through the game without combat, should you want to.Not every Väsen is in the playtest; you’ll find more in early access.Some tools and workstations will not be in the playtest.Building pieces, decorations and furniture will be limited.Some ingredients or materials will not be found in the playtest.You cannot rebind keys in the playtest; as such, Azerty keyboards may not be able to play the game as intended. The playtest is in English; it’s not localized in other languages.Known issuesPlease continue to report these issues, but be aware that you may potentially run into the issues noted below:Saving/loading Ensure you do not quit while the game is saving, as this may remove the textures of your character in that save.Dialogue Audio (both settings & sounds playing)  Host performance with many clientsDesync between client/hostThis means the client and host see different things when they're looking at the exact same thing and spot in the game.Optional: The thing we care about when reporting desync is probably "is it terrain, or "only" the stuff on top of the terrain, like stones, but we know this may not be easy to notice.Spawning (Väsen sometimes spawning in weird places, or players respawning in weird places, etc)For Väsen spawning in weird places, screenshots of both the location and map view would be great.Being unable to connect to another player. What we ask of you.We want to build this game alongside you, and to do that, we would be grateful for any and all feedback you send us. The best place is our Discord server, where we have a dedicated section for the playtest, but we know not everyone likes to use Discord. As such, please submit feedback via this form or by using the dedicated bug/feedback subforums here within Steam. Be sure to follow us on our Social Channels:X TikTok Instagram Trollheim.comJoin our Discord: https://discord.gg/HDH6exj6F5And Wishlist the game:

We're not inviting everyone right away, but we'll keep opening it up to more players over time, so don't worry if you don’t get in this round!Got an invite? You can invite up to 3 friends to join you! 🔒 The playtest is under NDA for as long as it stays closed. Please don't share any content about the game outside our dedicated Discord channels. The moment the playtest opens up, the NDA will be lifted, and everyone will be free to talk about it and share as much as they like. In the meantime, join our Discord, we can't wait to hear what you think!What to expect:This is a technical playtest, which means that some features that will be in the early access release are removed or turned off. As such, please submit feedback via this form!To close:We’re glad the Dark Forest found you. newsitems.title: Dev Diary - The World Building of TROLLHEIM: GNOMES.
newsitems.author: Seraxia
newsitems.contents: Trollheim, an original fantasy world, is based on the feelings evoked by ancient nature, harkening back to Nordic folklore where gnomes, trolls, sirens, and faeries are real. This seeps into every aspect of our worldbuilding, from the characteristics of the Troll Queen to the muted color palette of moss, boulders, and bark. The core of our stories is based on universal themes of humanity: to connect with yourself, each other, and nature, and we tell them through the untold tales of the lives, cultures, and adventures of väsen. Handcrafted art is used to create our characters, whether they begin in a lump of clay, with illustration on paper, or in our written stories. We then sculpt and draw them digitally with 2D and 3D artists, who also rig, animate, and bring them to life in the game.TROLLHEIM: GNOMES from Clay to GameOne of the first steps in our process to bring TROLLHEIM: GNOMES to life was to venture out into ancient nature. We brought the entire early development team out to the Tiveden forest to feel the timeless mystery of the wilderness—to touch the damp mossy boulders, drink from the clear creeks, climb the glacial erratics, breathe in the scents of humid caves, and witness the true stillness of forest lakes and misty bogs firsthand.Tiveden ancient forest, SwedenNot only are we inspired by real ancient Nordic nature—with its thick moss, tall pines, and heavy mist—but also by the feelings it evokes. This is where the mystery, wonder, and thrill of the unknown are derived. On an early morning, there is little way of knowing whether the mist over the still forest lake moves with the breeze, or whether it is the Tjärn Faeries dancing with the arrival of dawn. When you can search for blueberries on the forest floor, climb mossy boulders like they are mountains, or take the leap of faith from the top of one pine and land on another. These feelings are what make the Lost Dark Forest Realm of Trollheim magical. Dusk and dawn stretch themselves thin above the canopy, and the mist makes the forest feel both endless, thrilling, and safe. Yet, you are never alone. TROLLHEIM: GNOMES In game, procedural forestOur mythical beings are called Väsen, and they live their lives in the shadows of the Dark Forest. There are trolls, sirens, giants, faeries, gnomes, and many more—one of the tiniest among them is the Sprýg Gnomes. Standing tall at about 10 centimeters, these väsen are brave beyond measure. They live together as Revels in dwellings that blend into the organic shapes and earthy colors of the forest itself. Only revealed by the lit lanterns or the music from their many instruments. In the game, you are a part of the Last Revel in Midgård, and when you had nowhere else to turn, you were found by the Dark Forest.Ancient runes depicting the Sprýg Gnome’s journey to the Dark ForestThere is a variety of väsen who roam the wilderness. Although, due to their size, faeries, smaller trolls, lilvätt, and other gnomes are the more common encounters for sprýg gnomes. Therefore, these are the first characters you will meet in the game. Yet, there are many more who will be added in as time goes on. Perhaps the most well-known are the Skóug Trolls, who stand at three meters tall above you. They became beacons of hope and guidance when they entered the Dark Forest, and would continue to be so long after. However, at the time of the game, the Troll Queen Hilda had made a choice that shattered and divided the whole realm, after which she went into self-exile. With her whereabouts unknown, the Dark Forest faces troubling times ahead. Rumour has it, you may have been the last one to see her…Troll Queen HildaThe Väsen of the Dark Forest are as nuanced and flawed as any of us, they may be friendly, grumpy, or hostile, depending on the day. However, if you notice something feels off, listen to your instincts. For there are whispers of something spreading in the realm—Rotinn is an ancient force of decay, it corrupts the flora, fauna, and even the väsen themselves. It only shows itself through the tiny white mushrooms, from which its seeds spread. The corrupted väsen can become ill-intentioned and easily agitated, mirroring the greed found in Rotin-nor, Oden, and Midgård. It divides families, breeds resentment and isolation, and festers within the soul. In this Second Age of the Trollheim Saga, with the looming threat of Rotinn and the spread of its eternal decay—Molderökr—it may be up to the smallest yet bravest of väsen to rise to the occasion. The Sprýg Gnomes of the Dark Forest. Sprýg Gnomes of the Dark Forest Thankfully, the Dark Forest found you, and you will be able to make it your home. Here, in Trollheim, you can explore the unknown, belong, and thrive. We hope the same feelings that we felt walking through the real ancient Nordic forests will capture your heart and imagination as you play this game. newsitems.title: Гномы против скандинавских чудовищ - анонсирована кооперативная выживалка Trollheim: Gnomes
newsitems.contents: Разработчики представили дебютный трейлер Trollheim: Gnomes — приключенческого симулятора выживания, вдохновленного скандинавской мифологией. Действие игры разворачивается в сказочном королевстве Тролльхейм, населенном существами из скандинавского фольклора. По сюжету последние гномы народа Спрюг были изгнаны из Мидгарда Одином, поддавшимся таинственной порче. Теперь им предстоит найти новый дом в Тролльхейме, разыскать потерянных сородичей и научиться выживать среди троллей, фей, сирен и других мифических существ, известных как вэсены. Игроки смогут исследовать древний лес, собирать ресурсы, создавать инструменты и строить поселения прямо среди ветвей огромных деревьев. При этом обитатели леса будут далеко не всегда настроены враждебно: некоторые существа смогут помочь гномам, тогда как другие представляют смертельную опасность. Одной из главных особенностей Trollheim: Gnomes станет кооператив на восьмерых игроков, позволяющий вместе заниматься строительством, исследовать мир и противостоять опасностям волшебного леса.

newsitems.title: Introducing TROLLHEIM: GNOMES, an Upcoming Co-op survival game!
newsitems.author: tom
newsitems.contents: Welcome to the mystic Dark Forest of TROLLHEIM: GNOMES.Set in the World of Trollheim, prepare to enter the Dark Forest in a reimagined survival crafting game releasing later this year from Off-Leash Interactive, Trollheim Studios and Fireshine Games when TROLLHEIM: GNOMES launches into Steam Early Access. Adventure into a spellbinding wilderness through the eyes of a tiny gnome. Whether you take your first steps into the Dark Forest alone or with a group of 8, you will find mysteries to uncover, environments to explore, and mythical beings to befriend, possibly live with, or fight in this procedurally generated world rooted in ancient Nordic nature. If this seems like something you may be interested in, we have more information on IGN for you to explore! Be sure to wishlist the game and feel free to jump into our Discord, ask questions and get to know the team. We want to build our game alongside you, so we will regularly ask for your input as we approach early access and beyond, let's grow and explore the Dark Forest together! Connect with us on:Discord X TikTok Instagram
